en: Black‑and‑white, vertically oriented street view of a European town, showing a cobblestone main street lined with two‑ and three‑story buildings. At the left stands a tall church tower with an onion‑shaped spire topped by a cross and a clock on its facade. People in early‑20th‑century clothing, including children, walk or stand along the street. Shop signs hang from several buildings, but the resolution prevents reading them clearly. The sky is blank and overexposed, emphasizing the silhouette of the church tower.
